title: On the quasisymmetric functions in superspace
summary: Quasisymmetric functions in superspace were introduced as a natural extension of classical quasisymmetric functions involving both commuting and anticommuting variables. In this paper, we first provide a characterization of the algebra of quasisymmetric functions in superspace as an algebra of invariants under a quasisymmetrizing action of the symmetric group. Furthermore, we complete the superspace analogue of the classical hierarchy of combinatorial Hopf algebras by introducing the algebra of quasisymmetric functions in noncommuting variables in superspace.
